chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 10 (Full Book Model Paper 2)
subject: physics-10

questions.question: In simple harmonic motion of a mass-spring system, the acceleration of the mass is proportional to:
questions.explanation: In SHM, acceleration a = -(k/m)x is directly proportional to displacement x and always directed toward equilibrium.

questions.question: Human audible frequency range lies between:
questions.explanation: Normal human ears can detect sound waves with frequencies ranging from 20 Hz (lower threshold) to 20,000 Hz (upper limit).

questions.question: Total internal reflection occurs only when light travels from a/an:

options.A: Denser to rarer medium with angle of incidence greater than critical angle

questions.explanation: Total internal reflection requires light to travel from an optically denser medium to a rarer medium at an angle of incidence exceeding the critical angle (i > c).

questions.question: According to Coulomb's Law, if the distance between two stationary point charges is tripled, the electrostatic force between them is:
questions.explanation: F ∝ 1/r². When r' = 3r, F' = F / (3)² = F / 9.

questions.question: Three identical resistors of 6 Ω each are connected in parallel. Their combined resistance is:
How many Joules are equivalent to one commercial unit of electricity (1 kWh)?
A device that converts mechanical rotational energy into electrical energy using electromagnetic induction is a/an:
questions.explanation: An electric generator rotates a coil in a magnetic field to induce an alternating EMF, converting mechanical work into electrical energy.

questions.question: A NOR gate produces an active HIGH output (1) only when its inputs (A, B) are:
questions.explanation: A NOR gate is an inverted OR: Y = NOT(A OR B). Output is 1 only when neither input is 1 (i.e. A = 0 and B = 0).

questions.question: When a beam of cathode ray electrons enters an electric field between two oppositely charged plates, the electrons deflect toward the:
questions.explanation: Electrons carry negative charge (-e) and are electrostatic ally attracted toward the positively charged electrode.

questions.question: Which type of nuclear radiation has the highest specific ionization power in air?
questions.explanation: Alpha particles possess large mass and +2e charge, knocking electrons off gas atoms rapidly and creating intense ionization along short tracks.

questions.question: The time required for half of the radioactive nuclei in any given sample to disintegrate is termed its:
questions.explanation: Half-life T₁/₂ = ln 2 / λ is the characteristic duration during which 50% of the active parent nuclei decay.

questions.question: In a nuclear reactor, the rate of nuclear chain reaction is controlled by inserting control rods made of:
questions.explanation: Boron and cadmium are strong neutron absorbers; inserting them into the reactor core absorbs excess thermal neutrons to regulate the fission rate.
